title: Deep learning screens OCT images for vision-threatening conditions in high myopia
summary: Four InceptionResNetV2 convolutional networks trained on 5505 OCT macular images from 1048 patients with high myopia identified retinoschisis, macular hole, retinal detachment and myopic choroidal neovascularization. On an independent test set of 412 images from 91 patients recruited in 2019, AUCs were 0.961 to 0.999, with sensitivity equal to or better than retina specialists and specificity above 90%. Single-center study described as prospective.
ai_technology: Four InceptionResNetV2 convolutional neural networks classifying OCT macular images
organization: Zhongshan Ophthalmic Center, Sun Yat-sen University

evidence.tested: Independent test set of 412 images from 91 patients, separate from the training data.
evidence.unknown: Multicenter performance and clinical benefit are not established; full text not reviewed.
